blocks.text: Past Continuous (o'tgan davomli zamon) — **was / were + -ing**. Shakllari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 13–14-darslar). Ma'nosi Present Continuous ning o'tmishdagi aksi (→ 1-dars): o'tmishning **ma'lum bir paytida** harakat allaqachon boshlangan, lekin hali tugamagan edi — biz uning o'rtasidamiz. O'zbekchada unga «**-yotgan edi**» to'g'ri keladi: Soat sakkizda kechki ovqat **qilayotgan edik** — At eight we **were having** dinner. Ba'zan «**o'tirgan edi**», «**kiyib olgan edi**», «**kutib turgan edi**» ham shu ma'noni beradi.
Aniq paytda: at 8 o'clock, this time yesterday

Past Continuous har doim biror **tayanch nuqtaga** muhtoj: aniq vaqt (at ten last night, this time yesterday, at midnight) yoki boshqa voqea. Taqqoslang: At eight we **had** dinner — soat sakkizda ovqatlana **boshladik**. At eight we **were having** dinner — soat sakkizda ovqat **allaqachon boshlangan** edi, biz dasturxon atrofida edik. Birinchisi — nuqta, ikkinchisi — o'sha nuqtani qamrab olgan chiziq.

items.translation: Soat sakkizda **kechki ovqat qildik**. (shu paytda boshladik)

items.text: At eight o'clock we **were having** dinner.
items.translation: Soat sakkizda **kechki ovqat qilayotgan edik**. (allaqachon boshlagan edik)

items.text: What **were** you **doing** this time last year?
items.translation: O'tgan yili shu paytda nima **qilayotgan edingiz**?

blocks.text: Fon va to'satdan voqea: when / while

Eng ko'p uchraydigan qolip: uzoqroq davom etayotgan harakat (**Continuous**) va uni «bo'lib kirgan» qisqa voqea (**Simple**). **when** odatda qisqa voqea oldidan, **while / as** esa uzoq jarayon oldidan keladi: I **was cooking** when the phone **rang**. / While I **was cooking**, the phone **rang**. O'zbekchada: «Ovqat **pishirayotganimda** telefon **jiringladi**» — «-ayotganimda» qismi Continuous ga, «-di» qismi Simple ga mos keladi.

items.text: While Tom **was jogging** in the park, he **twisted** his ankle.
When the film **ended**, everyone **stood up** and **clapped**.

blocks.text: was doing yoki did? — jarayon yoki ketma-ketlik

Ikkala gap ham when bilan boshlanishi mumkin, lekin ma'nosi butunlay boshqa. Continuous — voqea paytida harakat **allaqachon davom etayotgan** edi. Simple — harakat voqeadan **keyin** boshlangan: avval biri, keyin ikkinchisi. Bundan tashqari, Continuous harakat tugaganmi-yo'qmi aytmaydi, Simple esa uni **tugagan** deb ko'rsatadi.

rows: When Kate arrived, we **were having** dinner.
1) ovqat allaqachon boshlangan; 2) Keyt kelgach boshladik
o'sha paytdagi manzara / butun voqea, tugagan
I **was walking** home when I saw her.

blocks.text: Ikki parallel jarayon va hikoyadagi manzara

Ikki jarayon bir vaqtda davom etgan bo'lsa, ikkalasi ham Continuous: While I **was ironing**, my sister **was watching** TV. Hikoya boshida manzara ham shu zamonda chiziladi: quyosh **charaqlab turardi**, odamlar **shoshib ketayotgan edi** — keyin asosiy voqealar Past Simple bilan keladi. Holat fe'llari (know, want, believe, belong) bu yerda ham Continuous olmaydi (→ 4-dars): I **knew** («I was knowing» ✗). **always** + Past Continuous esa — o'tmishdagi asabga tegadigan odat (→ 3-dars): He **was always losing** his keys.

items.text: While I **was ironing**, my sister **was watching** a series.
The sun **was shining** and the birds **were singing** when we set off.
items.translation: Yo'lga chiqqanimizda quyosh **charaqlab turar**, qushlar **sayrayotgan edi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I was go to work when ...» → I **was going** ... (`-ing` tushib qoladi); «I was knowing the answer.» → I **knew** the answer.; «While I cooked, the phone was ringing.» (rollar almashgan) → While I **was cooking**, the phone **rang**.; «-gan edi» ni doim Past Perfect deb tarjima qilish: «U qora kurtka **kiyib olgan edi**» → He **was wearing** a black jacket (holat o'sha paytda davom etyapti), «Stulda **o'tirgan edi**» → She **was sitting** on a chair.

Vaqt chizig'ini tasavvur qiling: Past Continuous — **uzun chiziq** (jarayon), Past Simple — uni kesib o'tgan **nuqta**. «Nima **bo'ldi**?» savoliga javob — Simple, «O'sha paytda nima **bo'layotgan edi**?» savoliga javob — Continuous.

Past Simple — 5-dars. O'tmishdagi voqeadan ham oldin tugagan harakat (When we arrived, the film **had** already **started**) → 15-dars; o'tmishgacha uzoq davom etgan jarayon (I **had been waiting** for an hour) → 16-dars. «was going to» — amalga oshmay qolgan reja → 20-dars.

rows: At ten last night I **was reading**.
Snow **was falling** and people **were hurrying** home.

examples.title: At a particular moment: this time yesterday
examples.description: O'tmishning aniq paytida davom etayotgan harakat: at 8 o'clock, this time yesterday, at midnight, in 2020. O'zbekchada «-yotgan edi».

sentences.text: At eight o'clock last night I **was sitting** in a traffic jam on the ring road.
sentences.translation: Kecha soat sakkizda halqa yo'lda tirbandlikda **o'tirgan edim**.

sentences.text: This time yesterday we **were flying** over the Caspian Sea.
sentences.translation: Kecha shu paytda Kaspiy dengizi ustidan **uchib ketayotgan edik**.

sentences.text: What **were** you **doing** at midnight? Your light was still on.
sentences.translation: Yarim tunda nima **qilayotgan eding**? Chirog'ing hali ham yonib turgan edi.

sentences.text: Madina **was preparing** for her exam at six this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab soat oltida Madina imtihoniga **tayyorlanayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: When I last saw Tom, he **was working** for a design studio in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Tomni oxirgi marta ko'rganimda, u Manchesterdagi dizayn studiyasida **ishlayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: At half past seven the children **were** still **sleeping**, so I made breakfast quietly.
sentences.translation: Soat yetti yarimda bolalar hali **uxlayotgan edi**, shuning uchun nonushtani jimgina tayyorladim.

sentences.text: **Were** you **driving** at the time of the accident, or was your wife?
sentences.translation: Avariya paytida siz **haydayotgan edingizmi** yoki xotiningizmi?

sentences.text: At 3 a.m. the whole city **was sleeping**, except for the bakers.
sentences.translation: Tungi soat uchda butun shahar **uxlab yotgan edi**, faqat novvoylar bundan mustasno.

sentences.text: In 2020 Aziz **was studying** in Seoul, so he missed his sister's wedding.
sentences.translation: 2020-yilda Aziz Seulda **o'qiyotgan edi**, shuning uchun opasining to'yiga kela olmadi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **wasn't listening** at that moment — could you repeat the question?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, o'sha paytda **quloq solmayotgan edim** — savolni takrorlay olasizmi?

examples.title: Interrupted actions: **was doing** when ... **happened**
examples.description: Uzoqroq davom etayotgan harakat (Continuous) va uni bo'lgan qisqa voqea (Simple). O'zbekchada «...-ayotganimda, ... -di».

sentences.text: I **was cooking** dinner when the electricity **went off**.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat **pishirayotganimda** elektr **o'chib qoldi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **was crossing** the road when a cyclist **hit** him.
sentences.translation: Jasur yo'lni **kesib o'tayotganida** uni velosipedchi **urib ketdi**.

sentences.text: We **were having** a picnic by the river when it suddenly **started** to pour.
sentences.translation: Daryo bo'yida **piknik qilayotganimizda** to'satdan jala **boshlandi**.

sentences.text: When the fire alarm **went off**, most people **were working** at their desks.
sentences.translation: Yong'in signali **chalinganda** ko'pchilik o'z stolida **ishlayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Kate **broke** her wrist while she **was skiing** in Austria.
sentences.translation: Keyt Avstriyada **chang'i uchayotganida** bilagini **sindirib oldi**.

sentences.text: My phone **rang** just as I **was going** into the exam room.
sentences.translation: Imtihon xonasiga **kirayotganimda** telefonim **jiringlab qoldi**.

sentences.text: Somebody **stole** Oliver's bag while he **was buying** a ticket.
sentences.translation: Oliver chipta **sotib olayotganida** kimdir uning sumkasini **o'g'irlab ketdi**.

sentences.text: When I **arrived**, the guests **were** already **dancing**.
sentences.translation: Men **kelganimda** mehmonlar allaqachon **raqs tushayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **was walking** her dog in the park when she **met** her future husband.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza parkda itini **sayr qildirayotganida** bo'lajak eri bilan **tanishib qoldi**.

sentences.text: The internet **stopped** working while I **was sending** my application.
sentences.translation: Arizamni **yuborayotganimda** internet **ishlamay qoldi**.

examples.title: **While**: two actions at the same time
examples.description: Bir vaqtda davom etgan ikki jarayon — ikkalasi ham Continuous: While I was ..., she was ... . while va as uzun harakat oldidan keladi.

sentences.text: While I **was making** the salad, my husband **was laying** the table for six guests.
sentences.translation: Men salat **tayyorlayotganimda**, erim olti mehmon uchun dasturxon **tuzayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: The kids **were playing** in the yard while their parents **were chatting** on a bench.
sentences.translation: Ota-onalar skameykada **gaplashib o'tirganida**, bolalar hovlida **o'ynayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: While Aziz **was driving**, Nilufar **was reading** the map aloud.
sentences.translation: Aziz mashina **haydayotganida**, Nilufar xaritani ovoz chiqarib **o'qib borayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: **Were** you **listening** to me, or **were** you **looking** at your phone the whole time?
sentences.translation: Meni **eshitayotganmiding** yoki butun vaqt telefoningga **qarab o'tirganmiding**?

sentences.text: Half the class **was sleeping** while the professor **was explaining** the formula.
sentences.translation: Professor formulani **tushuntirayotganida** sinfning yarmi **uxlab o'tirgan edi**.

sentences.text: As we **were walking** along the river, the sun **was setting** behind the hills.
sentences.translation: Daryo bo'ylab **ketayotganimizda** quyosh tepaliklar ortiga **botayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: James **was answering** emails while he **was waiting** for his flight.
sentences.translation: Jeyms reysini **kutayotganida** elektron xatlarga **javob berayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **was paying** attention while the manager **was talking** about the budget.
sentences.translation: Menejer byudjet haqida **gapirayotganida** hech kim **quloq solmayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: While my brother **was studying** for his finals, I **was working** at a summer camp.
sentences.translation: Akam bitiruv imtihonlariga **tayyorlanayotganida** men yozgi lagerda **ishlayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: The phone **was ringing** and the baby **was crying**, so I didn't hear the doorbell.
sentences.translation: Telefon **jiringlayotgan**, chaqaloq esa **yig'layotgan edi**, shuning uchun eshik qo'ng'irog'ini eshitmadim.

examples.title: In progress or in sequence? **were having** / **had**
examples.description: Continuous — voqea paytida harakat allaqachon davom etayotgan edi; Simple — voqeadan keyin boshlangan yoki tugagan. Juftliklar farqni ko'rsatadi.

sentences.text: When Kate arrived, we **were having** dinner, so she joined us at the table.
sentences.translation: Keyt kelganda biz **kechki ovqat qilayotgan edik**, u ham dasturxonga qo'shildi.

sentences.text: When Kate arrived, we **had** dinner together and then **watched** a film.
sentences.translation: Keyt kelgach, birga **kechki ovqat qildik**, keyin film **ko'rdik**.

sentences.text: As the teacher came in, the students **were talking** loudly.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi kirganda talabalar baland ovozda **gaplashayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: The students **stopped** talking the moment the teacher came in.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi kirishi bilan talabalar gaplashishni **to'xtatishdi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **was writing** a report yesterday afternoon, but I don't know if he finished it.
sentences.translation: Bekzod kecha tushdan keyin hisobot **yozayotgan edi**, lekin tugatdimi-yo'qmi, bilmayman.

sentences.text: Bekzod **wrote** a report yesterday and **sent** it to the director.
sentences.translation: Bekzod kecha hisobot **yozib**, uni direktorga **yubordi**.

sentences.text: It **was raining** when we left the cinema, so we waited inside.
sentences.translation: Kinoteatrdan chiqqanimizda yomg'ir **yog'ayotgan edi**, shuning uchun ichkarida kutdik.

sentences.text: It **rained** all day yesterday, and the streets turned into rivers.
sentences.translation: Kecha kun bo'yi yomg'ir **yog'di**, ko'chalar daryoga aylandi.

sentences.text: When the guests **left**, I **washed** the dishes and **went** to bed.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar **ketgach**, idishlarni **yuvdim** va **uxlagani yotdim**.

sentences.text: Sarah **was living** in Oxford when she **got** the job offer from Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Edinburgdan ish taklifini **olganida** Sara Oksfordda **yashayotgan edi**.

examples.title: Questions and negatives: What **were** you **doing**?
examples.description: So'roq — Was / Were + ega + -ing; inkor — wasn't / weren't + -ing. Savol → javob juftliklari.

sentences.text: What **were** you **doing** when the earthquake started? — I **was sleeping**.
sentences.translation: Zilzila boshlanganda nima **qilayotgan eding**? — **Uxlayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: **Was** Jasur **driving** too fast when the police stopped him?
sentences.translation: Politsiya to'xtatganda Jasur juda tez **haydayotgan edimi**?

sentences.text: Why **were** you **smiling** during the meeting? Did I say something funny?
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish paytida nega **jilmayib o'tirgan eding**? Kulgili gap aytdimmi?

sentences.text: I **wasn't paying** attention, so I didn't notice the speed limit sign.
sentences.translation: **E'tibor bermayotgan edim**, shuning uchun tezlik cheklovi belgisini sezmadim.

sentences.text: Who **were** you **talking** to on the phone when I came in?
sentences.translation: Men kirganimda telefonda kim bilan **gaplashayotgan eding**?

sentences.text: The printer **wasn't working** yesterday, so we couldn't print the contracts.
sentences.translation: Kecha printer **ishlamayotgan edi**, shuning uchun shartnomalarni chop eta olmadik.

sentences.text: Where **were** you **going** in such a hurry this morning?
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab bunchalik shoshib qayerga **ketayotgan eding**?

sentences.text: We **weren't expecting** visitors, so the flat was a complete mess.
sentences.translation: Mehmon **kutmayotgan edik**, shuning uchun uy ostin-ustin edi.

sentences.text: **Were** the children **wearing** helmets when they fell off their bikes?
sentences.translation: Bolalar velosipeddan yiqilganda dubulg'a **kiyib olgan edimi**?

sentences.text: Emma **wasn't feeling** well, so she left the party before dessert.
sentences.translation: Emma o'zini yaxshi **his qilmayotgan edi**, shuning uchun shirinlikdan oldin ziyofatdan ketdi.

examples.title: Setting the scene in a story
examples.description: Hikoyaning boshida manzara Past Continuous bilan chiziladi (fon), asosiy voqealar esa Past Simple bilan keladi.

sentences.text: It was a cold evening in January, and snow **was falling** softly on Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Yanvarning sovuq oqshomi edi, Samarqandga ohista qor **yog'ayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: People **were hurrying** home, and the shops **were closing** one by one.
sentences.translation: Odamlar uyga **shoshib ketayotgan**, do'konlar birin-ketin **yopilayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: In a small café near the station, an old man **was reading** a newspaper.
sentences.translation: Vokzal yaqinidagi kichik kafeda bir chol gazeta **o'qib o'tirgan edi**.

sentences.text: The radio **was playing** quietly, and the waiter **was wiping** the tables.
sentences.translation: Radio past ovozda **chalinayotgan**, ofitsiant esa stollarni **artayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Suddenly the door **opened** and a young woman **ran** in.
sentences.translation: To'satdan eshik **ochildi** va ichkariga bir yosh ayol **yugurib kirdi**.

sentences.text: She **was holding** a small box, and her hands **were shaking**.
sentences.translation: U qo'lida kichkina quti **ushlab turar**, qo'llari esa **qaltirayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Everyone **was staring** at her, but nobody **said** a word.
sentences.translation: Hamma unga **tikilib turgan edi**, lekin hech kim bir og'iz ham **gapirmadi**.

sentences.text: Outside, a car **was waiting** with its engine running.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida dvigateli o'chirilmagan mashina **kutib turgan edi**.

sentences.text: The old man **put down** his newspaper and **asked** her what **was happening**.
sentences.translation: Chol gazetasini **qo'ydi** va undan nima **bo'layotganini so'radi**.

sentences.text: At that moment, the sound of a police siren **was getting** closer and closer.
sentences.translation: Shu payt politsiya sirenasining ovozi tobora **yaqinlashib kelayotgan edi**.

examples.title: State verbs and **always**: **knew** / **was always losing**
examples.description: Holat fe'llari (know, want, believe, belong) o'tgan zamonda ham Continuous olmaydi. always + Past Continuous — o'tmishdagi asabga tegadigan odat.

sentences.text: I **knew** the answer, but I was too nervous to say it out loud.
sentences.translation: Javobni **bilardim**, lekin uni ovoz chiqarib aytishga juda hayajonlangan edim.

sentences.text: At that time Bekzod **wanted** to become a pilot, not an engineer.
sentences.translation: U paytda Bekzod muhandis emas, uchuvchi bo'lishni **xohlardi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **believed** his story, because it **sounded** too strange.
sentences.translation: Uning hikoyasiga hech kim **ishonmadi**, chunki u juda g'alati **eshitilardi**.

sentences.text: The car **belonged** to my uncle, so I **was driving** it very carefully.
sentences.translation: Mashina amakimga **tegishli edi**, shuning uchun uni juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan **haydayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: We **were having** lunch when Sarah called, but we **had** no idea about the news.
sentences.translation: Sara qo'ng'iroq qilganda biz **tushlik qilayotgan edik**, lekin yangilikdan **xabarimiz yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: My old flatmate **was always borrowing** my clothes without asking.
sentences.translation: Avvalgi xonadoshim kiyimlarimni so'ramasdan **nuqul olib kiyardi**.

sentences.text: As a child, Jasur **was constantly getting** into trouble at school.
sentences.translation: Bolaligida Jasur maktabda **tinmay** baloga **qolardi**.

sentences.text: Grandad **was forever telling** the same jokes, but we still **loved** them.
sentences.translation: Bobom **nuqul** o'sha hazillarni **aytib yurardi**, lekin biz ularni baribir **yaxshi ko'rardik**.

sentences.text: **Did** you **understand** what the speaker **was talking** about?
sentences.translation: Ma'ruzachi nima haqida **gapirayotganini tushundingizmi**?

sentences.text: I **didn't recognise** Madina at first because she **was wearing** sunglasses and a hat.
sentences.translation: Avvaliga Madinani **tanimadim**, chunki u quyosh ko'zoynagi va shlyapa **taqib olgan edi**.

examples.title: Mixed: witnesses and news reports
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: guvohlar ko'rsatmasi va yangiliklar — fon (Continuous) va voqealar (Simple) bitta gapda.

sentences.text: The witness said the man **was wearing** a black hoodie when he **left** the bank.
sentences.translation: Guvohning aytishicha, erkak bankdan **chiqqanida** qora kapyushonli kofta **kiyib olgan edi**.

sentences.text: According to the police, the lorry **was travelling** at over a hundred kilometres an hour.
sentences.translation: Politsiya ma'lumotiga ko'ra, yuk mashinasi soatiga yuz kilometrdan oshiq tezlikda **ketayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Two climbers **were coming** down the mountain when the storm **hit**.
sentences.translation: Ikki alpinist tog'dan **tushib kelayotganida** bo'ron **boshlandi**.

sentences.text: While engineers **were repairing** the bridge, traffic **moved** very slowly.
sentences.translation: Muhandislar ko'prikni **ta'mirlayotganida** transport juda sekin **harakatlandi**.

sentences.text: Fortunately, nobody **was standing** near the building when the wall **collapsed**.
sentences.translation: Baxtimizga, devor **qulaganida** bino yaqinida hech kim **turmagan edi**.

sentences.text: I **was scrolling** through the news when I **saw** a photo of my own street.
sentences.translation: Yangiliklarni **varaqlayotganimda** o'z ko'chamning suratini **ko'rib qoldim**.

sentences.text: The prime minister **was visiting** a school in Leeds when the scandal **broke**.
sentences.translation: Janjal **chiqqanida** bosh vazir Lidsdagi bir maktabga **tashrif buyurayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: What **were** the passengers **doing** when the pilot **announced** the emergency landing?
sentences.translation: Uchuvchi favqulodda qo'nishni **e'lon qilganida** yo'lovchilar nima **qilayotgan edi**?

sentences.text: Our neighbours **weren't** at home when the pipe **burst**, so water **was pouring** into our flat for hours.
sentences.translation: Quvur **yorilganida** qo'shnilarimiz uyda **yo'q edi**, shuning uchun soatlab kvartiramizga suv **oqib turdi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **was working** as a journalist in London when he **decided** to return to Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Aziz Londonda jurnalist bo'lib **ishlayotganida** Toshkentga qaytishga **qaror qildi**.
